# Brain views

> Shows a Workspace member what the Brain knows about one thing, where one statement comes from, or where one process instance stands, each as a bounded view with one starting point.

## Purpose

| `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/R-2` |  | The dossier (PMVP-30a): one thing's name and kind, its facts - each with the document its source passage is in, or the mark «ohne Beleg» - and its documents, read as the person signed in, behind the switch brain_views.enabled. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/brain_views/dossier.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/brain_views_routes.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/dossier.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/css/brain_views.css` |

### Not responsible for

- The modellers' views of the Platform: Ansichten (Graph, Ablauf, Baum, Board, Liste, Matrix, Definitionen, Dokumentation, Lücken), Cortex and the custom views. They read the tenant's whole edge list (graph_views/topology.py) and stay outside this card (graph_views/, views_routes.py, ontology_graph.py, custom_views/).
- A whole-graph screen for members; a member reaches a view from a result, an answer or a name typed into the box (B-02, B-05).
- The links from names in search results and answers to the dossier; the search page (the web app) and the assistant draw them (PMVP-33).
- Who may read a node, a fact or a document: the Core decides, and answers 404 for what the person may not see (graph_api.py). Serving a document's file: the web app's file routes and their gate (app.py, document_grants.py); the dossier hands them the node's documents through the web app's grant, as the search page does with its rows.
- The switch's place on the settings page and its storage (platform_settings.py, settings_routes.py); this card holds what the one registry entry means.

### Terms

- dossier (the page for one thing - what the Brain knows about it)
- Beleg-Spur (evidence trail - the way from a statement to its passage and document)
- process line (one process instance - its main path, the current step and what is missing)
- ohne Beleg (the mark of a fact that has no source passage the person can open from the dossier)

## To review

| At | Why |
|---|---|
| `/owner` | Proposed owner, as for every card in this repository; one role per component is confirmed by a person (Software Map K4). |
| `/status` | Live or planned is not read from the code: the dossier (PMVP-30a) is built on the Platform MVP's branch, behind a switch that is off by default, and not on main yet. |
| `/source_paths` | The plan builds the views as a new module, src/brain_views/ (§ 5.2); PMVP-30a added the dossier (brain_views/dossier.py, its route file, its template and its stylesheet). The existing views the plan's state table lists under "Brain views" (Ansichten, Cortex, custom views) are left out: they read the tenant's whole edge list once per person (graph_views/topology.py) and have no 25-node limit (plan § 3), so they could not keep P-1 and P-3. If PMVP-32 takes the plan's cut (2) - the process line becomes the existing Ablauf view (graph_views/process_views.py and its page) in the new look - that code joins this card or gets one of its own; the coordinator decides then. The wiring (one register_blueprint call in app.py) and the switch's registry entry (platform_settings.py) stay in files no card holds. |
| `/operations` | The two the code reader shows. create_brain_views_blueprint has no line: the plan's contract deltas (section 7) give none, and its one caller is the web app's wiring. PMVP-30b to PMVP-34 add theirs. |
| `/uses` | Declared, as the code reader does not follow the client's methods to the routes they call. The web app's file routes (preview_document, download_document in app.py) and its grant (\_grant_for_current_user) are used too; app.py has no card. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/*/P-1` | No evidence; PMVP-34 writes the 25-node limit as one shared function with its test (plan § 11). The dossier draws one node with its facts and documents; the related things by kind, and with them the limit, are PMVP-30b's. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/*/P-2` | Holds for the document, not yet for the passage. A fact's source is the Core's provenance_pointer (the document), provenance_chunk_id (the passage) and provenance_status; no per-thing route returns a passage's text or its page, so the dossier opens the document at its start (a PDF in the browser's viewer, any other file handed over), not at the passage, and shows no passage text. A fact whose document the Core did not list among the node's documents for this person is marked «ohne Beleg» even when it has a passage: the Core shows a fact when any one of its evidence chunks is readable (graph_access.visible_fact_ids), so its provenance document is not known to be readable. PMVP-31 (evidence trail) brings the passage. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/*/P-3` | The evidence covers the dossier (PMVP-30a); PMVP-30b to PMVP-32 bring theirs. The whole-graph export answers an error for the Knovas tenant (inbox IN-2026-11-10-03, plan § 3). |
